analysis: Adrenal insufficiency leads to electrolyte imbalances and metabolic changes due to decreased production of aldosterone and cortisol. It is associated with hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, and hypoglycemia, and typically results in metabolic acidosis rather than alkalosis. Thus, metabolic alkalosis is not associated with adrenal insufficiency.
